_note: Register fragment for woo-national-output-assurance (REQ-WNO-004). One wooPipelineIncident per failure of the Woo publication pipeline, raised through PipelineIncidents::raise(), which coalesces an identical open incident within 24 hours. The schema's notification rule tells the members of the incident-receiver role by Nextcloud notification and e-mail; the Woo settings assign that role the group named in app config woo_incident_group. Admin-only.

wooPipelineIncident.comment: One failure of the Woo publication pipeline, open until resolved

wooPipelineIncident.title: Woo pipeline incident
wooPipelineIncident.summary: A failure of the Woo publication pipeline that a named group must look at
wooPipelineIncident.description: Records one failure of the Woo publication pipeline: a readiness check, a refused sitemap, a failed batch, a failed national hand-over, a sitemap gap or a superseded DiWoo version. The incident group is told when one is created.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What failed, such as plooi-delivery or diwoo-version.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: What it failed for, such as a publication or a catalogue.

message.title: Message
message.description: The reason, as a person reads it.

resolvedAt.title: Resolved at
resolvedAt.description: When someone marked it resolved; empty while it is open.
